_comment: Single source of truth for Trellis brand identity. Edit this file, then run `node js-build/generate-branding.mjs` to regenerate the derived locale files. CI runs the generator in --check mode to enforce that the committed files stay in sync. See INDEPENDENCE.md.
_identityComment: Reference values for the rest of the app's identity. These are not auto-generated yet (they live in application.ini, resource/config.mjs, app/win/installer/defines.nsi, app/mac/Contents/Info.plist). The brand-consistency check asserts the app ID below matches application.ini and resource/config.mjs.
